add_library(augusta_protocol STATIC protocol.cpp proto/augusta.proto)
target_include_directories(augusta_protocol PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include)
target_link_libraries(augusta_protocol PUBLIC augusta_math augusta_tick PRIVATE augusta_limits protobuf::libprotobuf)
augusta_set_module_scope(augusta_protocol SHARED)

# The C++ of the one schema (ADR-0007), generated by vcpkg's protoc into the
# build tree and never checked in: augusta.pb.h, which only protocol.cpp
# includes, so it stays private to the module (checks/protocol_boundary.cmake).
# protoc's code is third-party code: compiled without warnings, which -Werror
# (/WX) would make errors, and included as a system header.
set(AUGUSTA_PROTOCOL_GENERATED_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated)
protobuf_generate(
  TARGET augusta_protocol
  LANGUAGE cpp
  OUT_VAR protocol_generated
  IMPORT_DIRS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/proto
  PROTOC_OUT_DIR ${AUGUSTA_PROTOCOL_GENERATED_DIR}
)
#
# On Windows, vcpkg builds the protobuf DLL with MSVC, for which protobuf's
# headers make PROTOBUF_RESTRICT nothing, while under clang-cl they make it
# __restrict, which the mangled names of the functions the generated code
# imports (InternalSwap and memswap) then carry, and the DLL's exports lack.
# The generated code is compiled with __restrict defined away there, so it
# imports the names the DLL exports.
set_source_files_properties(
  ${protocol_generated}
  PROPERTIES
    COMPILE_OPTIONS $<IF:$<CXX_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT:MSVC>,/w,-w>
    COMPILE_DEFINITIONS $<$<AND:$<CXX_COMPILER_ID:Clang>,$<CXX_COMPILER_FRONTEND_VARIANT:MSVC>>:__restrict=>
)
target_include_directories(augusta_protocol SYSTEM PRIVATE ${AUGUSTA_PROTOCOL_GENERATED_DIR})
